title: Several injured in shooting and fire at Michigan Mormon church
summary: Police say the shooter "is down" and there is no further threat to the public, but the church building is still on fire.

title: Multiple people shot at Mormon church in Michigan and shooter is down, police say
summary: Multiple people have been shot at a Mormon church in Michigan and the shooter is down, police said Sunday.

title: Star-studded Global Citizen Festival reminds attendees of their power with million-dollar pledges
summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Global Citizen surpassed its fundraising goals for Amazon rainforest protection, African energy access and community education at the antipoverty nonprofit’s annual music festival in New York’s Central Park, headlined by Shakira and late addition Cardi B.
